sections.summary: Automatic ad groups are ad groups Pinterest Performance+ generates on the advertiser's behalf during campaign creation.

claims.text: Pinterest Performance+ automatically creates ad groups during the campaign create flow.

evidence.locator: All Pinterest Performance+ campaigns automatically receive one automatically generated ad group

claims.text: Every Performance+ campaign automatically receives one auto-generated ad group.

evidence.locator: All Pinterest Performance+ campaigns automatically receive one automatically generated ad group

claims.text: For Sales campaigns, a prospecting ad group (All Products) plus a Dynamic Retargeting ad group are generated, with a third ad group when a customer list is added.
